_comment: Snake locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, worst to best); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Player Snake on a {width}×{height} grid.
Anao kontrola ilay {player_id}. Latsaky ny hatramin'ny '[up]'/'[down]'/'[left]'/'[right]' (na w/s/a/d).
Tantana: velona lavitra indrindra na ho lavitra indrindra ary ahazoana ny marika avo indrindra (sehatra ny fiposahan'ny {max_turns} fiposahan).

game_action.invalid_death: Maty noho ny hetsika tsy mety ny bibilava {player_id}.

outcome.survived_win: Ny mpilalao {player_id} no tafavoaka velona; maty ny hafa rehetra.
outcome.all_dead_simul: Maty niaraka tamin'izay ny bibilava rehetra.
outcome.outlived: Nihoatra ny an'ny hafa rehetra ny mpilalao.
outcome.turn_limit: Nahatratra ny fetran'ny fihodinana - ny isa tsara indrindra no mandresy amin'ny fifandirana.
